versions.content: File Storage Description: Persistency shall support access to file-like structures. Additional Information: Data needs to be read and written from files inside folders, and associated meta data (e.g. access time) needs to be available. Files can contain UTF-8 text or binary data. Rationale: PSE51 does not contain file system support.
